title: Crewbrain — demo v3
ttsInstructions: Speak like a calm, confident product founder showing a colleague something that works. Plain, warm and direct, a brisk but unhurried pace, no hype. Short natural pauses between sentences.

ownerVoice.text: Brief Bay Roofing's crew for the Oak Street job, until the job closes Friday at six.
ownerVoice.instructions: A busy solar contractor talking into his phone on a job site. Casual, clear, quick, one breath.

segments.narration: Meet Sam. He runs a small solar company, and every job depends on what's in his head, and on his phone.
Same question, two helpers. The homeowner's helper declines. The crew's helper answers, in Spanish.
Crewbrain turns what's in the owner's head into voice helpers. Say one sentence to create one. They only see what they should. And they switch off when the job is done.

segments.headline: One sentence.
segments.caption: Sam taps the mic and just says what he needs.
segments.narration: Highlight one: say it, get a helper. Sam taps the mic, and says one sentence.

segments.headline: One sentence.
segments.caption: Spoken, not typed. Live voice.
segments.narration: “Brief Bay Roofing's crew for the Oak Street job, until the job closes Friday at six.”

segments.headline: One card to approve.
segments.caption: Who it's for, what it knows, what it can do, when it ends.
segments.narration: Crewbrain heard who it's for, which job, and when it ends. Claude works out the rest: what the crew may know, what Rex can do, and what it can't see, like the price book. It all fits on one card, and nothing goes live until Sam approves.

segments.headline: Live. Send the link.
segments.caption: Each roofer gets a personal link, by text or QR code.
segments.narration: One tap, and Rex is live. Each roofer gets a personal link, by text, or as a QR code on site. No setup screens, no settings.

Highlight two: helpers only see what they should. The company brain runs on HydraDB, and every source carries an access list. Here is one real query, run as the household and as the crew. The crew gets the site brief. The household never does. And the price book comes back for neither.

segments.headline: Answers, with the source.
segments.caption: Rex answers the crew in Spanish and shows where it came from.
segments.narration: On the roof, Marco asks Rex in Spanish where to park, and what the safety rules are. Rex answers in Spanish, and shows the sources it used: the site brief, and the crew's safety rules.

segments.headline: Crew details stay with the crew.
segments.caption: Warranty: answered. Gate code: never retrieved.
segments.narration: Anita's helper, Juno, answers her warranty question, with its source. But the site brief is locked to the crew. So when she asks for the gate code, Juno never retrieves it, and can't share it.

segments.headline: Photo report.
segments.caption: Marco snaps it. Rex files it.
segments.narration: Helpers also get work done. Marco snaps a photo of cracked flashing, and Rex files a report.

segments.headline: Straight to Sam's inbox.
segments.caption: Photo, note, who sent it, and when.
segments.narration: It lands in Sam's inbox, with the photo, the note, and who sent it.

segments.headline: Updates go through Sam.
segments.caption: Rex drafts it. Sam approves it.
segments.narration: Then Marco asks Rex to tell the Patels the dumpster comes at seven thirty. Rex drafts the update, and sends it to Sam first.

segments.headline: One tap to approve.
segments.caption: Nothing reaches the homeowner until Sam says so.
segments.narration: Sam checks it, and approves with a tap.

segments.headline: The homeowner hears it.
segments.caption: An update from Rivera Solar & Electric.
segments.narration: Anita's helper shows the update, from Rivera Solar and Electric.

segments.headline: Unknown? Ask Sam.
segments.caption: Questions the brain can't answer go to the owner.
segments.narration: When Juno doesn't know, like whether they can add an EV charger, the question goes to Sam.

segments.headline: Answer once. The brain learns.
segments.caption: Sam's reply goes to Anita and into the brain.
segments.narration: Sam answers in one line. Anita gets the reply, and the brain improves, so next time Juno already knows.

segments.headline: Close Rex.
segments.caption: The roof is done. Rex is still live.
segments.narration: Highlight three: access ends with the job. On Friday the roof is done. Sam says: close Rex.

segments.headline: One tap.
segments.caption: The crew loses access right away.
segments.narration: He confirms.

segments.headline: This helper has ended.
segments.caption: Marco asks again. The chat stops on the spot.
segments.narration: On the roof, Marco's chat is still open. He starts another question, and it stops: this helper has ended.

segments.headline: Back to office only.
segments.caption: The site brief and its gate code are locked again.
segments.narration: And the site brief, with the gate code, goes back to office only. Access ended with the job.
Under the hood: HydraDB holds the knowledge and the permissions. Claude does the reasoning and the actions. Realtime voice lets anyone just talk.
And the whole test suite passes.
Crewbrain. Your company's know-how, on every job, with the right access, for the right amount of time.
